custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active tracked part, part A, for this test with 5 in its bin.
  • Make sure no Cycle count is running on the Inventory list.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839415-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839415-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • A cycle count is running when the Inventory list shows a Count column with Save and Cancel above it; click Cancel to stop it.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The count starts: part A has an empty Count box, and the Active and Inactive tabs are still shown.

Step 3:

  • Part A's Count box shows 7.

Step 4:

  • The Inactive tab opens straight away: no question or warning about unsaved counts appears.

Step 5:

  • The Active tab is selected.

Step 6:

  • Part A is listed with 5 Available: the 7 typed before switching tabs was dropped and nothing was counted.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List)

  • S1-E1: “The tabs stay available during a Cycle count. Switching tabs before saving drops the counts typed so far, without asking, the same as changing the search or a filter during a count.”
  • S1-R10: “Cycle count is offered on both tabs. It counts the parts on the tab that shows, and the printed count sheet lists those parts.”

From: Jira tickets and comments under epic SV-10647 (saved in sources/jira-2026-10-27/ALL-TICKETS-2026-10-27.md), read 27 Oct 2026

  • SV-10814, Chris Ward, 23 Oct 2026: “Switching tabs during a cycle count drops the unsaved counts without asking, the same as changing search or a filter in count mode today. Keep the tabs enabled during a count, as board 5.7 shows.”
